name: Long Suffering Of God The
overview: The long-suffering of God is vividly illustrated in the story of Manasseh, who despite his rebellion and the affliction brought upon him through captivity, humbled himself and turned to the LORD in prayer, resulting in God's gracious restoration (2 Chronicles 33:10-13). This patience is not without limit, as seen in the warning of the evil servant who abuses the delay of his master, highlighting that God's forbearance should lead to repentance rather than despising His kindness (Matthew 24:48-49). Thus, God's long-suffering is a key aspect of His character, exemplified in His dealings with Israel and His people, urging sinners to repent and receive forgiveness through Christ's intercession.
